title: Upgrades to National Grid and Energy Infrastructure to Accommodate New Energy Sources
what_it_is: Upgrades to National Grid and Energy Infrastructure to Accommodate New Energy Sources

sections.label: Grid upgrades and energy sources
sections.summary: EMA works with SP Group on grid upgrades to keep power stable while adding solar, low-carbon imports, and a planned ammonia power plant.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Energy Market Authority (EMA) works closely with the SP Group to plan for and implement the necessary upgrades and expansion of our grid infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This helps to ensure a stable and a reliable power system in Singapore, even as we complement our natural gas power plants with new energy sources, such as solar panels, low-carbon electricity imports from the region, and other sources that are still currently under study.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As we have previously communicated in this House, SMRs have yet to be fully commercialised.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As for ammonia, we are developing an Ammonia Pathfinder project for pilot-scale power generation and marine bunkering.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: For power generation, the plan is to deploy a 55- to 65-megawatt (MW) ammonia power plant by 2028.

sections.label: Future Energy Fund uses
sections.summary: Part of the Future Energy Fund is envisaged for infrastructural investments such as interconnectors, but earmarked amounts cannot yet be stated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For the Future Energy Fund, I have shared earlier on, I believe it was at the Budget or Committee of Supply debate this year, that in some of the infrastructural investments, particularly pertaining to interconnectors, that is what we envisage part of the Future Energy Fund will be used for.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: It would be premature at this particular point in time to talk about what amounts have been ear-marked.

sections.label: SMR commercial deployment sites
sections.summary: The number of sites where one SMR has been deployed in a commercially and economically feasible segment has yet to be demonstrated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The number of sites where one SMR has been deployed in a commercially and economically feasible segment, has yet to be demonstrated.

sections.label: Waiting for data, US agreement
sections.summary: They are waiting for data to come out and have just entered into the 123 Agreement with the United States.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are waiting for data to come out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have just entered into an agreement, the 123 Agreement with the United States.
